title: Uniform dimension-scaled near-identity RPCD bound
statement: For every n-dimensional unit-diagonal SPD B with mu=lambda_min(B) and theta=n(1-mu), the exact RPCD sweep decrease matrix satisfies K(B)>=[1+theta/sqrt(2)]^{-2}mu B^{-1}. Hence theta<=1 implies K>(mu/4)B^{-1} and O(n/mu log(1/epsilon)) updates; theta<=2-sqrt(2) implies the sharp half coefficient.
assumptions: Uniform fresh random permutation per sweep
The complexity corollary uses theta bounded by a numerical constant
open_objections: The bound loses a dimension-free constant when n(1-mu) is unbounded.
No Lean formalization, priority audit, or outside-human validation exists.
